描述_EN: some of the bird's painted surface is covered with fragments of clear glass; its clay body and wire legs covered with pink fur. the head is also covered in glass fragments, and the neck in long glass beads. the bird was was made in china, probably for export, as it is an example of the birds often used in western europe as christmas decorations. this toy bird, resembling a peacock, is possibly a christmas tree ornament: at the base of the neck is a small metal loop which would allow the bird to be suspended.
描述_ZN: some of the bird's painted surface is covered with fragments of clear glass; its clay body and wire legs covered with pink fur. 头部也覆盖着玻璃碎片，脖子上有长长的玻璃珠子。 这只鸟是在中国制造的，可能是为了出口，因为它是一个在西欧作为圣诞装饰品经常使用的鸟的例子。 这只玩具鸟，类似于孔雀，可能是一个圣诞树的装饰品：在脖子的底部有一个小的金属环，可以让鸟悬空。
